jobs.objective: Install/enforce a MANUAL TAKEOVER GUARD for browser/UI automation. If user activity is detected in the controlled browser/window while QQ automation is active (typing, clicking, focus/selection changes, navigation, form edits, or other human interaction), immediately pause/cancel conflicting queued and active browser actions, relinquish UI control, and enter MANUAL state. Never click Next, Continue, Submit, Sign in, Create, authorize, or equivalent boundary actions while MANUAL state is active. Do not resume browser automation merely because the user becomes idle; resume only after a new explicit user instruction authorizes automation. Preserve unrelated non-UI work. Apply this as a durable default for MEMORIA browser/UI tasks and reconcile it on self-heal/restart. Keep the current browser automation STOPPED after installation.
